inner.title: runway in months
inner.body: cash divided by monthly net burn, stated in months, in every update. slush found only 18% of european founders say raising money is easy right now.
inner.label: only 18%

inner.title: your burn multiple
inner.body: net burn divided by net new arr shows what each euro of growth costs. crv says above 3x is a red flag unless growth is exceptional.
inner.label: 3x red flag

inner.title: where your mrr sits
inner.body: berlin vc point nine frames seed to series a as growing from 10k to 100k mrr. show where you sit on that line, every month.
inner.label: 10k to 100k

inner.title: the number that dropped
inner.body: if a number went down, include it with what you're doing about it. pitchwise says investors who only see good news stop trusting the updates.
inner.label: include it anyway

inner.title: send before 10am
inner.body: send it the first monday or tuesday, before 10am in your main investors' time zone. send quarterly and they read 90-day-old numbers.
inner.label: monthly, not quarterly

closer.HEADLINE:
investors don't need good news.
they need the same five
closer.TONIGHT: work out your runway in months
